mapper.sql: create_time ,update_time,bool_delete_enum,version, id, artifact_type_id, structure_classification_id, min_numerical, max_numerical
mapper.select: SELECT sctl.id, sctl.min_numerical, sctl.max_numerical, ssc.classification_name, ssc.id AS classificationId, mbsp.price, mbsp.wage_quota_type, link.id AS process_link_id, mbsp.id AS processPriceId, link.process_id AS processId, mbp.name, ss.spec_prefix from mes_building_structure_classification_type_link AS sctl LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification AS ssc on ssc.id = sctl.structure_classification_id and ssc.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_product_process AS mbpp on mbpp.type_id = sctl.structure_classification_id and mbpp.product_type = 2 and mbpp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_product_process_link AS link ON link.product_process_id = mbpp.id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_structure_process_price AS mbsp ON mbsp.structure_type_link_id = sctl.id AND mbsp.process_id = link.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process AS mbp on mbp.id = link.process_id and mbp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_structure_spec as ss on ssc.id = ss.structure_classification_id and ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE sctl.artifact_type_id = #{id} and sctl.bool_delete_enum = 0
